photos.notes: Two-page alphabetical index spread of the '60s Countdown' book, photographed rotated 90 degrees (landscape). Decade tab headings run across the top (1969, 1968, 1967, 1966 on the left page; 1964, 1963, 1962, 1961, 1960 on the right page) but are decorative tabs, not column groupings. Four columns are printed: TITLE, ARTIST'S NAMES, YEAR, PAGE. Per the task (composer column only), artist and year are NOT recorded in composer_printed because they are recording-artist names, not composers. Artists/years printed alongside each title include e.g. Diana Ross 1967, Temptations 1966, 5th Dimension 1969, Four Tops 1964, Creedence Clearwater Revival 1969, Beach Boys 1965, etc. RIGHT-page entries (alphabetically from 'Knock on Wood' onward) have legible page numbers, recorded above. LEFT-page entries (A through 'It's Up to You') had their PAGE column cut off / illegible at the photo's edge, so recorded as page null. A few left-page titles ('The Shadow of Your Smile', 'Sunny', 'Sweet Pea') were faint; transcribed as best read. Some page numbers are uncertain due to small print.

photos.notes: 'CONTENTS' page for '59 Piano Solos You Like to Play' (matches cover IMG_5653), though no book title is printed on this contents page itself. Organized alphabetically by composer; each composer's name is printed in small caps with birth/death location and year info, recorded verbatim (best effort) in composer_printed. Diacritics on composer names and some titles (e.g. Dvorak, Saint-Saens, Traumerei, Tannhauser, Faure, piu) could not all be confirmed at this resolution and have been transcribed in plain ASCII where uncertain. 'Anitra's Dance' (Grieg) page number was illegible between 68 and 71, recorded as null. The Grieg group lists Album-Leaf, Anitra's Dance, To Spring, March of the Dwarfs in that order. Page numbers otherwise read from both gutter (left column) and far-right (right column) number columns.
